_readme.what: Nether blocks in Overworld structures, swapped when a template loads (patcherMod worldgen/TemplateBlockSwaps). python3 tools/gen_nether_swaps.py expands these rules over every template into exact positions in nether_block_swaps.json; rerun it after editing this file or after mod updates.
_readme.rules: In order; the first rule that matches a block at a position wins. structures: ids (or ["*"] = every Overworld structure); except: ids skipped; except_holding: block selectors, skips every structure any of whose templates holds a matching block ("@sculk" = the sculk structures); blocks: block ids, "@nether", "@nether_bricks" or "@sculk"; to: a block id (state properties carry over per the generator's KEEP table, else by id suffix: trapdoor, button, pressure plate, slab, stairs, wall, wall torch, lantern, log/wood/hyphae/stem), "air" (removed), or "deepslate" (the nether brick family to its deepslate brick twin; a fence becomes a wall).
_readme.safety: A template any Nether or End structure can also place is never swapped (Nether builds keep their blocks).
